survivors.reason: When the type assertion fails, fn is the nil function, so returning it is the same as the nil returned after the if.

Only matters when customdecode.ExpressionClosureFromVal is called directly with a value of another type, since try and can, its only callers, receive arguments that go-cty has already checked against the expression closure type.

Leaves customdecode.ExpressionType unset, which only affects applications that declare it as a parameter or attribute type through the Go API, and neither the adapter nor any hashicorp/hcl package uses it.
